name: 펜리르

sources.title: 님블뉴런 공식 실험체 스킬: 숨통 끊기

visual_review: 원본 회갈색 머리·날카로운 눈·주황 꼬리와 검은 의상을 유지했습니다. 보호막 준비에서 수평 습격·발톱 적중·VF 회수로 연결되며 몸 자세와 꼬리가 움직입니다.
motion_summary: Fenrir olive-gray messy hair with animal-like tufts, fierce narrow eyes, black/orange coat and segmented orange tail from identity. Official R gains shield while preparing then quickly rushes target and links VF drain. Animate resting clawed hands; low stalking crouch; arms crossing with a thin orange-violet barrier; tail curling; brief charged predatory pause; hard launch forward; lunging claws with body nearly horizontal; sharp paired claw strike; orange VF tether curling back toward his hand, braced low; recoil; tail relaxes; original idle. No generic wolf summon; this humanlike character and his own tail do the attack. Preserve face and outfit, readable mouth.
